title: Devtooling builders session
description:
A chance for Ethereum devtool builders to get together and share experiences.
We will begin with a short panel hosted by EF Builder Enablement team and facilitated by Austin Griffith, where Ethereum devtool builders share how they fund their projects, use AI in their work, and adapt their tools for people building with agents.
The panel will set up a wider conversation. Austin will guide a group activity to help people meet, compare experiences, and bring their own questions into the discussion.
Bring something you are working on, a problem you face, or a lesson to share.
